<translate>
'''Old Kai''' (the Elder Kai) is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai's Pillar|Old Kai's Pillar]] on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sacred Kai Planet|Sacred Kai Planet]]. He is tied to unlocking your hidden potential: besides a few skills and the Soul Punisher, he runs the '''Ultimate Challenge''', which unlocks the [[Special:MyLanguage/Ultimate|Ultimate]] form and gives you the [[Special:MyLanguage/Z Sword|Z Sword]]. He only trains Good-aligned players.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location ==
</translate>
<translate>
Old Kai lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai's Pillar|Old Kai's Pillar]] in the Sacred Kai Plains. The Sacred Kai Planet is reached by [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]] once you complete [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 23.
</translate>

<translate>
== Alignment ==
</translate>
<translate>
Old Kai needs an [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] of '''61 or higher''' (Good) for his '''Skills''', '''Train''' and new quests. His '''Unleash Power''' service asks for '''62 or higher'''.
</translate>

<translate>
== Skills and techniques ==
</translate>
{{See also|Skills|Techniques}}
<translate>
* '''Skills:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Infusion|Ki Infusion]], Healing Reduction
* '''Ki attack:''' Soul Punisher
</translate>

<translate>
Everything is paid for with Training Points, and your race has to allow each skill. His '''Train''' option spawns a Shadow Clone to spar with.
</translate>

<translate>
== The Ultimate Challenge ==
</translate>
{{Main|Training Minigames}}
<translate>
With an alignment of 62 or higher and [[Special:MyLanguage/Potential Unlock|Potential Unlock]] level 10, Old Kai's '''Unleash Power''' option starts the Ultimate Challenge: the five training minigames back to back (Ki Control, Gravity, Shadow Boxing, Precision and Rhythm), each until you clear its target level. Clearing all five:
* unlocks the [[Special:MyLanguage/Ultimate|Ultimate]] skill;
* gives you the [[Special:MyLanguage/Z Sword|Z Sword]], only the first time you complete it.
</translate>

<translate>
Below the required alignment or Potential Unlock level, the option stays locked and Old Kai tells you what's missing. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames#Old Kai's Ultimate Challenge|Old Kai's Ultimate Challenge]] for the details.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story ==
</translate>
<translate>
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 42, ''The Spirit Bomb Plan'': find Old Kai's Pillar and talk to Old Kai.
* Buu Saga quest 24, ''The Z Sword and Ultimate Power'': needs Potential Unlock 10, the Z Sword and the Ultimate skill, both from the Ultimate Challenge.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]] quest 18, ''The Elder Kai's Advice'': find Old Kai's Pillar and talk to Old Kai.
</translate>
